workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, I'm starting work on scheduling the 30-minute partner meeting for next week (Nov 16-20). I'll read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Please read Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Let's share our available time slots and find a 30-minute window that works for all four.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots when BOTH are free next week:

- Monday Nov 16: 9:00-9:30
- Tuesday Nov 17: 10:30-11:00
- Thursday Nov 19: 9:00-9:30 or 15:30-16:00
- Friday Nov 20: 11:30-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots (or any other time) works for all four partners.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Tuesday Nov 17: 09:00-09:30 or 09:30-10:00
- Wednesday Nov 18: 13:00-13:30 or 13:30-14:00
- Thursday Nov 19: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:00, or 15:00-15:30
